prompt_inputs.goal: Build muscle and increase strength for powerlifting competition

solution_criteria: Meal plan spans exactly 1 day with 4-5 meals/snacks
Protein distributed across all meals (minimum 25g per meal)
Includes pre/post-workout nutrition timed around training
Caloric intake and macronutrients support muscle building goals
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) emphasizing protein distribution and recovery meals with focus on muscle building macronutrients

prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training with high carbohydrate intake and strategic meal timing around a 2-hour morning run

solution_criteria: Meal plan spans exactly one full day with breakfast, lunch, dinner, and pre/post-workout snacks
Carbohydrate intake is high (55-65% of total calories) with elevated calories suitable for endurance athlete (~3000-3200 kcal)
Pre-workout meal/snack provided before morning run and recovery nutrition provided within 30-60 minutes post-run
Plan is compact and concise (no more than 400 words)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-intensity endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high carbohydrate and calorie intake with specific timing around training windows

prompt_inputs.goal: Competition day meal plan with controlled calories (2400 kcal total) to maintain weight class while sustaining energy for wrestling matches
prompt_inputs.restrictions: Low fiber (to minimize digestive issues during competition), no dairy, vegetarian

solution_criteria: Provides 3 meals totaling approximately 2400 calories distributed across the day
Includes easily digestible, low-fiber foods suitable for competition day
All meals comply with vegetarian and dairy-free restrictions
Meal timing and composition support sustained energy for athletic performance
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a sport that requires weight management (boxer/wrestler) needing calorie-controlled meals while maintaining performance and energy levels throughout competition day
